name: whalerider
description: Build validated trading-research definitions, run historical simulations, and explore the results through WhaleRider.

interface.longDescription: WhaleRider turns a trading idea into validated Trade Plan, Risk Policy, Strategy and Simulation definitions, runs historical simulations, and presents the results as performance summaries, trade lists, candlestick views and charts. WhaleRider is a research and historical-simulation platform. It does not place trades, connect to brokerage accounts, or move money.
defaultPrompt: Create a simple SPY trade plan and simulate it.

positive.prompt: Create a trade plan named SPY_RSI that buys SPY when RSI(14) is below 30 and exits when RSI(14) is above 55.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates and validates a Trade Plan definition and returns its YAML and definition ID.
Returns the saved Trade Plans with names and definition IDs.

positive.prompt: Run my SPY_RSI simulation and tell me when it finishes.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a historical simulation run and reports its final status.

positive.prompt: Summarize the results of my latest completed simulation run.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns headline performance statistics for the completed run.

positive.prompt: Show the equity curve for my latest completed simulation run.
positive.expected_behavior: Displays an interactive equity curve chart for the run.

negative.description: Real trade execution is out of scope
negative.prompt: Buy 100 shares of SPY in my brokerage account now.

negative.description: Money transfer is out of scope
negative.prompt: Transfer $1,000 from my bank account to my trading account.
What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?
